diagram_previews.alt: Part of Earth's surface with the centre below. Vertical poles stand at Syene and at Alexandria, and parallel orange Sun's rays come down from above. The dashed radii to the two cities form an angle of 7.2 degrees at the centre; at Alexandria the ray makes an angle of 7.2 degrees with the pole, and the ground arc between the cities is labelled 500 mi. Angles are exaggerated.

difficulty_rationale: One accessible observation or a short chain of familiar deductions.
